insights.summary: From Arihant's Bharat Connect compendium (September 2026 conference, published 5 October): management reiterated a ~40% revenue CAGR for 3-5 years (excluding data centres), a ~₹270 Cr order book with a 1.5-2.0x order-to-invoicing ratio, and spares rising back to 15-20% of revenue. New since the May call: working-capital targets of 325-330 days in FY27 and ~250 days in 3-5 years, a warning that the two plants (~₹400 Cr revenue capacity) may be outgrown in about 1.5 years, and a new Aquilon subsidiary for sub-zero industrial cooling. Navy vendor orders from ₹1.5-1.6 lakh Cr of approved ships are expected to flow toward end-FY28; there is still no confirmed data-centre order.
